decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application for minor amendments to the previously approved scheme for the construction of a new basement, demolition of existing rear extension and erection of a two storey rear extension, enlargement of rear bay windows on ground floor level, the formation of lightwells to front and rear with steps, (with glazed barrier, the installation of a side window on first floor level and installation of 5 roof lights to main roof to house, as shown on drawing numbers, 602/11B, 602/12A, 602/ 13A, 602/ 14A, 602/ 15A, 602/ 16A and 602/17A, received 21 February 2006, is recommended for approval as the proposed development would not harm the appearance of the existing building or the amenity of neighbouring properties. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The building shall not be used any time other than for a single dwelling. The basement shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling.
description: Construction of a new basement.  Demolition of existing rear extension and erection of a two storey rear extension, enlargement of rear bay windows on ground floor level.
